channels.label: Source install
manualProof: Start from a clean checkout or source archive.
Open the app locally and export a portable workspace bundle.
Record OS, Node version, and browser used.

channels.label: Docker Compose
manualProof: Boot app and API services from Docker Compose.
Confirm the API data volume persists after restart.
Record backup path or backup artifact.
channels.acceptedRisk: Registry publishing and digest pinning are not required until public container distribution.

channels.label: Hosted web/API deployment
channels.artifactType: Static web app plus long-running API service
channels.entrypoint: npm run start && npm run start:api
manualProof: Confirm hosted app URL and API health endpoint.
Open Backend Health and record persistence, email, backup, and public-surface status.
Submit a feature request or invite email if enabled.

channels.label: Offline PWA
channels.entrypoint: Open hosted app and install from browser
manualProof: Install from Android Chrome or a desktop browser.
Launch in airplane mode or with networking disabled.
Create a local edit and export a portable bundle while offline.
channels.acceptedRisk: Native iOS/Android wrappers are not shipped; offline mobile proof is PWA-only.

channels.label: macOS desktop shell
manualProof: Pack on macOS and record signing/notarization status.
Launch with networking disabled.
Create a local edit and export a portable bundle.
channels.acceptedRisk: Unsigned/not notarized is acceptable for v0.1 beta only if release notes repeat it.

channels.label: Windows desktop shell
manualProof: Pack on Windows and record signing status.
Install/uninstall or launch portable executable.
Launch with networking disabled, create a local edit, and export a portable bundle.
channels.acceptedRisk: Unsigned installer is acceptable for v0.1 beta only if release notes repeat it.

channels.label: Agora CLI
manualProof: Run quick verification from a fresh shell.
Inspect at least one portable bundle.
Generate demo links for the release demo URL.

channels.label: Local MCP server
channels.artifactType: stdio MCP server for local power-user clients
manualProof: Run the MCP integration test.
Confirm read-only default behavior.
Record whether write tools are enabled and why.

channels.label: Portable workspace bundle
manualProof: Validate portable workspace fixtures.
Preview an import before applying it.
Run a restore drill from the selected backup or bundle.
